avoid.description: Deliberate exclusions. The renderer honours these.

exploration.description: Visual theses considered before any coordinate was written. Concise authoring metadata, not private reasoning.

dominantArtifact.description: The one thing the eye should land on.

allowBleed.description: This element is meant to run past the slide edge. Without it, anything outside the slide is reported as a defect.

intentionalOverlap.description: Marks a deliberate collision so QA does not report it.

place.description: Placement stated against elements already on this slide. Any axis given here wins over the literal x/y/w/h, and is solved into inches before the slide is composed.

sameAs.description: Take the referenced element's width or height.

spanFrom.description: With spanTo, stretch from one element's near edge to another's far edge.

gap.description: Distance held from the referenced element, in inches.

offset.description: Added after everything else, in inches.

anyOf.description: A relation to an element declared earlier on the same slide.

children.description: Child elements. Their x/y are offsets from the group's x/y, in inches.

scale.description: Uniform scale applied to every child offset and size. Defaults to 1.

id.description: Unique within the slide; used by validation and revision.

zIndex.description: Paint order. Lower values sit behind.

role.description: Semantic role, e.g. title, body, caption, decorative.
